requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
2 years of experience with distributed systems architecture, scalability, reliability and performance optimization.
1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).
1 year of experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.
1 year of experience developing, fine-tuning, or deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in production environments.
Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
Experience in system design for large-scale distributed systems using programming language C++.
Experience in data analysis of high-throughput streaming data and integrating real-time insights into systems.
Research experience in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field (e.g., campus lab experience, research internships, or co-authored papers).
Strong understanding of ML systems, genAI technology, and Recommender Systems.
High velocity to iterate, strong ownership to land projects end-to-end and comfortable collaborating and supporting multiple client teams.
